6242351244736021110:
Woody is the new Dog in the Forsaken Quarter, but right after arriving, he noticed something strange about this place—children would "grow" out of the corners of The Ash Pit! And they "grew" incredibly fast. Sometimes, just as you spotted someone passing by, there would suddenly be a tiny child wrapped in tattered cloth.
Woody reported this to the leader of the dogs on Goldwater Street—Big Smart.
But Big Smart didn’t believe it. After all, the children it had seen were all pampered in courtyards, with two adults trailing behind like tails—one feeding them, the other draping clothes over them. How could children possibly "grow" out of The Ash Pit?
It wasn’t until Woody took Big Smart for a walk around the Forsaken Quarter that Big Smart finally admitted: there really were bizarre cases of children "growing" out of thin air.
So, what should they do now?
Looking at the child’s pale face, Big Smart brought over its little blanket, and Woody brought a bamboo-woven turtle it had found on the road. When the child didn’t react, Big Smart fetched a Meaty Bone, and Woody brought its favorite Wild Mushroom... Yet the little mouth remained silent.
At their wits' end, the two dogs barked anxiously—until they heard a voice behind them—
"So noisy! What’s all the barking about... Huh? Where did this little one come from?! Someone—quick, someone come here!"
